title: SKE Crystal Blue Razz Gummy Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: SKE Crystal Blue Razz Gummy Nic Salt captures the tangy sweetness of Blue Raspberry with a soft, confectionery-inspired finish. The Blue Raspberry flavour is bright and zesty, offering a sharp burst of berry on the inhale. This is followed by a sweet, chewy note that mimics the nostalgic taste of fruity gummies, adding texture and depth to the overall profile. This e-liquid strikes a playful balance between tangy and sweet, making it a great option for vapers who enjoy fruity flavours with a nostalgic twist. It's vibrant, slightly sour, and softened by its smooth finish, creating a moreish vape you can return to throughout the day. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nic salt formula is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. It's available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths and offers a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine delivery. SKE is renowned for delivering bold, satisfying flavours with sleek, user-friendly design. Their Crystal Bar disposables helped set a new standard for flavour clarity and convenience, and the SKE Crystal Nic Salt range continues that legacy "offering the same popular flavours in a format compatible with a wide range of refillable pod kits and MTL vape devices. With a presence in over 50 countries, SKE remains at the forefront of vaping innovation.
